note: 40 verified, 36 survivable — three rooms are closed or unverifiable (Uncle Jack's on West 56th, Tuscany, Angus Club) and Boucherie Union Square was withdrawn in content wave 1's fix round as a brasserie, the Balthazar shape the rule excludes. The densest of the fourteen. 27 of the census stand in Midtown between 34th and 58th Street, with a second cluster in the Financial District and the Village. Five are already published by the neighbourhood corpus and must be linked to their existing owners rather than recreated: Keens (manhattan/garment-district.json), Delmonico's (manhattan/financial-district.json), COTE (manhattan/flatiron-district.json), Old Homestead (manhattan/meatpacking-district.json) and Wolfgang's Park Avenue (manhattan/murray-hill.json). korean_bbq/manhattan.json has an empty places list and owns none of them. This page also carries the note folding in the six Bronx rooms.

19 verified, 17 survivable — Hunter's Steak & Ale House closed in April 2026 and Embers could not be confirmed as trading. Four clusters: Williamsburg and Greenpoint (4, not counting Peter Luger, who is published elsewhere), the kosher steakhouse belt (5, and it runs wider than Midwood and Borough Park — 40th Street in Borough Park, Avenue J in Midwood, East 7th Street in Gravesend and Kingston Avenue in Crown Heights), Bay Ridge and the Court Street corridor (4) and Downtown Brooklyn (2). The kosher belt is the borough's second real cluster. Two rooms are already published: Peter Luger (brooklyn/south-williamsburg.json, whose node is south-williamsburg rather than williamsburg) and Gage & Tollner (brooklyn/downtown-brooklyn.json).

17 verified, 17 survivable, and the borough's steakhouse is South American rather than prime beef. 8 of the 17 sit on the Argentine and Brazilian parrilla belt through Jackson Heights, Elmhurst and Corona; Astoria adds two steak rooms, one of them Greek-American; the remaining seven are outliers in Fresh Meadows, Rego Park, Bayside, Forest Hills, Flushing (two) and South Ozone Park. Iron Age Korean Steakhouse is already published by queens/rego-park.json.

6 verified rooms against a bar of 8, which is what decided it. The borough does have a nameable cluster — Jake's, Arnauld's and Riverdale Steak House are all in Riverdale, 3 of the 6 — so it fails on count, not on shape. The rest are scattered across Throgs Neck and Parkchester, and NYY Steak and Lobel's fail the venue-embedded test. Folded into a note on the Manhattan page.

4 verified rooms against a bar of 8, and unlike the Bronx there is no cluster either: Tompkinsville, St. George, South Beach and Bulls Head, one room each. Two opened in the last four years and none has verifiable history; Raval's own marketing calls it the island's only authentic steakhouse. This path does not exist in destination_tree.json and, because the city is dropped, no node needs to be added.

37 verified, 28 published — nine rooms fell out in content wave 3: Goodman Canary Wharf, Gaucho Charlotte Street, Gaucho Smithfield and Sophie's Chelsea are not on their operators' own site lists; Zelman Meats Soho, M Restaurant Threadneedle Street, Ibai and Chelsea Grill could not be confirmed as trading; and Boisdale of Belgravia is a Scottish restaurant with steaks rather than a steak room. Nine of the 37 are in the World's 101 Best Steak Restaurants 2026. The core is Mayfair, Soho and the City, but Hawksmoor's seven sites, Blacklock's four and Gaucho's two published here spread the corpus across the boroughs.

24 verified, 20 published plus 3 linked — the one loss is La Grande Boucherie, withdrawn in content wave 2 as an Art Nouveau brasserie on the same reasoning that withdrew Boucherie Union Square from Manhattan. Every room is inside the city limits, and unlike korean_bbq no suburban split. Korean BBQ's mass fled Lawrence Avenue for Niles and Glenview; the steakhouse mass never left River North, the Gold Coast, the Loop and the West Loop, which hold 21 of the 24. The other three are Korean steakhouses already published by korean_bbq/chicago.json: Iron Age Wicker Park, Perilla Steakhouse and Shinhwa Korean Steakhouse. Suburban Gibsons Oak Brook and Rosemont are not needed.

24 verified, 18 published — six fell out in content wave 2: Smith & Wollensky Century City and Wolfgang's Beverly Hills are not on their operators' own location lists, Nusr-Et Beverly Hills closed in June 2025, and Dunsmoor, Vaca DTLA and Dan Tana's are a heritage wood-fire room, a Spanish restaurant and an Italian one rather than steak rooms. The 24 verified stood across three municipalities: 15 in the City of Los Angeles from Koreatown and Downtown out to Echo Park, Hollywood, Venice and the Valley, 7 in Beverly Hills and 2 in West Hollywood. The 18 published break down the same way minus the six drops: 12 in the City of Los Angeles, 5 in Beverly Hills and 1 in West Hollywood. No split, because the City of Los Angeles sustains a page on its own. Following korean_bbq's puget-sound.json, the guide sits on this node while each room carries the node it is actually in, so Task 3 must create united-states/california/beverly-hills and united-states/california/west-hollywood.

15 verified, 11 published plus 3 linked — the one loss is Brazen Head, withdrawn in content wave 2 as a Cow Hollow continental bar that merely serves a good steak. All are inside the city, and unlike korean_bbq no South Bay page pulling the mass south. Clusters: the Van Ness and Nob Hill spine (3), Union Square (3), the Financial District and Embarcadero (3), Marina and Cow Hollow (2), Market and SoMa (2), with the Design District and the Mission behind them. Three Union Square rooms are already published by san_francisco/union-square.json: Morton's, Alexander's Steakhouse and ABSteak by Akira Back.

22 verified, 16 published — six fell out in content wave 2: Spencer's for Steaks and Chops, Red Cow and BOCA at Queen City Grill could not be confirmed as trading inside the city, The Grill From Ipanema turned out to be a Washington DC room, the census's two JaK's Grill rows collapsed to the one JaK's actually inside the city limits, and Daniel's Broiler Downtown is named in prose because no source gave it a street address to hang a place row on. The rest are inside the city limits, so the page is Seattle and not Puget Sound. This is the sharpest inversion of korean_bbq, whose Seattle guide had to become a regional page because the grills were four suburban corridors up to forty miles out. Steak concentrates in the downtown and Belltown business core, with Capitol Hill, Ballard, Queen Anne and the lake neighborhoods behind it; Bellevue's John Howie Steak is not needed.

12 verified rooms: Back Bay 5 along Boylston, Berkeley and Arlington, the Seaport 4, Beacon Hill 1 and Downtown 2. Ocean Prime is a Seaport room at 140 Seaport Boulevard, not a Back Bay one. No Boston place corpus exists yet, so none of the twelve is already published.

17 verified, 13 published — four fell out in content wave 3: The Prime Rib could not be confirmed as trading, and Charlie Palmer Steak, Smith & Wollensky and Medium Rare Capitol Hill are not on their operators' own DC location lists. The page is the District only, not the District plus Northern Virginia. The same rule as Seattle decides it: measure inside the limits first and extend only if the core cannot sustain a page. It can, on the K Street power-dining corridor with a second node in Georgetown. Northern Virginia's Tysons and Arlington chain corridor is dense enough to be its own page one day but is not one of the fourteen candidates.

7 verified rooms against a bar of 8. The correction that moved it: The Ruxton opened in March 2024 in the former Fleming's space at 720 Aliceanna Street, and the first pass counted both as separate rooms. Same address, successive tenants, one room. Dropped rather than merged into Washington DC, because a merge puts the rooms on the target page and Baltimore City rooms on a page named Washington DC would misname it across a state line and forty miles, contradicting the District-only ruling on that row.

20 verified, 16 published — four fell out in content wave 3: Ocean Prime, Meat Market and Los Ranchos Bayside are not on their operators' own location lists, and Red South Beach's domain has lapsed with nothing confirming the room trades. The 20 verified stood across four municipalities rather than a split: 9 in Miami proper in Brickell, the Design District, Little River, Little Havana, Little Haiti and Downtown, 8 in Miami Beach where South of Fifth carries the spectacle rooms, 2 in Coral Gables and 1 in Aventura. The 16 published break down the same way minus the four drops: 7 in Miami proper, 6 in Miami Beach, 2 in Coral Gables and 1 in Aventura. Kept as one page because Miami proper sustains a page on its own and the city's own tourism board publishes a single steakhouse list spanning all four. Following korean_bbq's puget-sound.json, Task 3 must create united-states/florida/miami-beach, united-states/florida/coral-gables and united-states/florida/aventura.
